svg.title: A stuck heater: the residual settles and the leak gives it away
svg.desc: The heater sticks on at step 120 and the thermostat switches it off. The residual is positive for a few steps and then settles back to zero, because the model's field moves to a level where the room barely leaks. The leak the model believes in, averaged over twenty steps, falls below anything an ordinary day produced and the monitor rings 8 steps after the fault.
svg.text: what the room did minus what the model said
